name: fitforge-federation
description: App acadêmico de academia com React e Webpack Module Federation

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SHELL,TREINOS,PROGRESSO -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @fitforge/shell" "npm run dev -w @fitforge/workouts" "npm run dev -w @fitforge/progress"
scripts.build:remotes: npm run build -w @fitforge/workouts && npm run build -w @fitforge/progress
scripts.build: npm run build:remotes && npm run build:shell && node scripts/assemble.mjs
scripts.check: npm test && npm run build && npm run test:integration
